info.title: F1 Replay API
info.description: Replay historical Formula 1 races as if live: browse imported races, control replays, read the authoritative race state, detected events and timing series, and stream live updates over WebSocket (`/api/v1/replays/{replay_id}/stream`).

get.description:
Authoritative race snapshot with drivers ordered by position.

409 ``REPLAY_NOT_STARTED`` before the replay starts; 404 ``RACE_STATE_UNAVAILABLE``
when nothing has been processed yet. The final state stays available after completion.
Position, gaps, laps, tyres, pit status and recent laps of one driver.

Detections of a replay ordered by source sequence, event type and id.

``driver`` matches either the primary or the secondary driver.
